name: std::array<T,N>::rbegin, std::array<T,N>::crbegin
intro: Returns a reverse iterator to the first element of the reversed array. It corresponds to the last element of the non-reversed array. If the array is empty, the returned iterator is equal to rend().

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Reverse iterator to the first element.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: The underlying iterator of the returned reverse iterator is the end iterator. Hence the returned iterator is invalidated if and when the end iterator is invalidated.

examples.output:
Print 'arr' in direct order using [cbegin, cend):        ▁ ▂ ▃ ▄ ▅ ▆ ▇ █
 
Print 'arr' in reverse order using [crbegin, crend):     █ ▇ ▆ ▅ ▄ ▃ ▂ ▁
